name: Routing — ModelGateway, NonOpenAI provider
summary: ModelGateway connection (distinct from ApiManagement) fronting an OpenRouter / LiteLLM / DeepSeek backend.
description: ModelGateway is a separate ConnectionCategory (string 'ModelGateway'). It requires an explicit modelDiscovery block and supports model.format values OpenAI | Anthropic | NonOpenAI | Deepseek. Skips if AI_GATEWAY_CONNECTION_MODELGATEWAY is unset.
notes:
BYOM routing through ModelGateway is not interchangeable with APIM routing.

`ModelGateway` supports OAuth2 `client_credentials`; `ApiManagement` supports AAD/MI.
